tags.documentation: Input (unscaled) Minimum for Scaling

tags.name: Err_Alarm

tags.name: Err_EU
tags.documentation: 1=Error in Config: Scaled EU Min = Max

tags.documentation: 1=Error in Config: PV filter params (RateTime, TC)

tags.name: Err_Raw
tags.documentation: 1=Error in Config: Raw Input Scaling Min = Max

tags.name: Err_Timer
tags.documentation: 1=Error in Config: On Delay, Off Delay, Gate Delay Time Invalid (use 0 to 2147483 s)

tags.name: Inp_PV
tags.documentation: Input Signal (process variable) from Sensor

tags.documentation: 1=PV or I/O Comms Status Bad, 0=OK

tags.name: Inp_PVUncertain
tags.documentation: 1=PV Value Not Reliable, 0=OK

tags.documentation: 1=Use simulated PV (Set_SimPV); 0=Use Input (Inp_PV)

tags.documentation: Operator Command to Clear the captured min / max PV excursion values

tags.documentation: Operator Command to Reset all Alarms requiring Reset

tags.documentation: Operator Command to Reset and Acknowledge all Alarms

tags.name: Sts_Fail
tags.documentation: 1=Analog Input is Out of Range or PV Bad

tags.documentation: 1=Analog Input is above High limit

tags.name: Sts_HiHi
tags.documentation: 1=Analog Input is above High-High limit

tags.name: Sts_InpPV
tags.documentation: 1=Using Input PV (normal)

tags.name: Sts_Lo
tags.documentation: 1=Analog Input is below Low limit

tags.name: Sts_LoLo
tags.documentation: 1=Analog Input is below Low-Low limit

tags.documentation: 1=A Maintenance Bypass is Active, display icon

tags.name: Sts_PVBad
tags.documentation: 1=PV Bad quality or Out of Range

tags.name: Sts_PVUncertain
tags.documentation: 1=PV Value is Uncertain (quality)

tags.name: Sts_SubstPV
tags.documentation: 1=Using Substitute PV (Input being overridden)

tags.name: Val
tags.documentation: Analog Value (after Substitute PV, if used)

tags.documentation: Device Fault Status 0=none, 20=Lo, 21=Hi, 24=LoLo, 25=HiHi, 32=Fail, 34=CfgErr

tags.name: Val_HiHiLim
tags.documentation: Current High-High Status Threshold

tags.name: Val_HiLim
tags.documentation: Current High Status Threshold

tags.name: Val_InpPV
tags.documentation: Analog Input Value (actual, before Substitute PV selection)

tags.name: Val_LoLim
tags.documentation: Current Low Status Threshold

tags.name: Val_LoLoLim
tags.documentation: Current Low-Low Status Threshold

tags.name: Val_Notify
tags.documentation: Current Alarm Level and Acknowledgement (enumeration)

tags.name: Val_PVEUMax
tags.documentation: Maximum of scaled range = MAX (Cfg_PVEUMin, Cfg_PVEUMax)

tags.name: Val_PVEUMin
tags.documentation: Minimum of scaled range = MIN (Cfg_PVEUMin, Cfg_PVEUMax)

tags.name: Val_PVMaxCapt
tags.documentation: Captured PV Maximum (excursion) since last cleared

tags.name: Val_PVMinCapt
tags.documentation: Captured PV Minimum (excursion) since last cleared
